jobs.occupation: PhD-Student (m/w/d) (Bioinformatiker/in)
jobs.description:
PhD-Student (m/f/d)

Join an interdisciplinary research project at the interface of neurobiology, RNA biology, and bioinformatics. The aim of this PhD project is to decipher the regulatory mechanisms underlying RNA dysregulation in response to environmental and viral stressors. Using innovative brain organoid models, you will apply computational and experimental approaches to investigate the effects of microplastics and/or HSV-1 infections on RNA regulation in models of Alzheimer's disease and healthy controls. The insights gained are expected to contribute to a better understanding of the development and progression of neurodegenerative diseases.

As part of this PhD project, you will employ state-of-the-art sequencing and analytical techniques to investigate how environmental factors and viral infections influence RNA regulation in the human brain. Particular emphasis will be placed on understanding the molecular mechanisms that may contribute to the onset and progression of neurodegenerative diseases.

- Analyze alterations in RNA regulation in the human brain using single-cell transcriptomics and long-read RNA sequencing.
- Investigate key RNA regulatory processes, including alternative splicing, RNA isoform usage, polyadenylation dynamics, and transposable element activity.
- Explore the effects of HSV-1 infections and genetic risk factors on RNA isoform diversity and regulation.
- Integrate and analyze transcriptomic and epitranscriptomic datasets to identify disease-relevant molecular mechanisms.
- Compare data from human brain organoid models with datasets from Alzheimer’s disease patients to assess the disease relevance of the models.
- Develop and apply bioinformatics approaches for the analysis of complex multi-omics datasets.
- Present and discuss research findings within the team and at national and international scientific conferences.
- Contribute to scientific publications in leading international peer-reviewed journals.
- Opportunity to expand the project to additional molecular layers, including proteomics, metabolomics, and lipidomics.
- Completed Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Molecular Biology, Neuroscience, or a related field.
- Strong enthusiasm for RNA biology and research into neurodegenerative diseases.
- Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Analysis of RNA sequencing and other omics datasets (bulk, single-cell, and/or long-read data)
- Programming and data analysis, particularly using Python and/or R
- Ability to work independently in a structured and goal-oriented manner.
- Strong teamwork and communication skills, with enthusiasm for collaborating in interdisciplinary and international research environments.
- Excellent written and spoken English skills.

Desirable Qualifications

- Experience in the analysis of RNA isoforms, alternative splicing, or epitranscriptomic datasets.
- Knowledge of multi-omics data integration and analysis.
- Interest in organoid models and translational biomedical research.
- Practical experience in experimental molecular biology, such as cell culture, organoid technologies, or RNA sequencing.

You also benefit from:

- a remuneration in accordance with the collective agreement for the federal public service (TVöD-Bund), including additional company pension schemes
- a secure job
- flexible working hours and childcare support
- the possibility of mobile working
- an idyllic green campus, which is easily accessible by bicycle, public transport or car
- free use of Nextbike from the Buch S-Bahn station to the campus
- Subsidy for the job ticket as well as discounts in the campus canteen
- On-campus health and fitness center
- additional health benefits such as flu vaccination, eye test, ergonomics advice at the workplace

Please use our online portal and submit your application including a cover letter, CV (without photo, age and information about your family status) and other relevant attachments.

If you have a foreign degree, please submit proof of the recognition of your Master's degree in Germany with your application. The proof can be determined via the anabin database and can be submitted as a PDF attachment to the application. Further information can be found at Recognition of Degrees and Achievments (https://www.mdc-berlin.de/content/guide-new-scientists?mdcbl%5B0%5D=/de/careers/work-life/welcome-family-office&mdctl=0&mdcou=0&mdcot=0&mdcbv=tJ1UjFVrtLpkXBiasnNmx9Fg_yO3rbFr98ICfu5rb0w) .

jobs.occupation: (Associate) Test Equipment Design Engineer, Tesla Engineering Germany (m/f/d) (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

The Test Engineering (Germany) team drives the development and delivery of world-class test solutions that accelerate product development and deepen engineering understanding across Tesla's vehicle programs. By leveraging Tesla's technology and engineering culture, the team builds efficient, flexible, and highly capable test infrastructure that directly influences the quality and pace of next-generation EV development. As a Test Equipment Engineer within the Germany division, you will be a critical contributor to test equipment design, build, and operation efforts spanning high voltage distribution, battery systems, structural and vibration validation, drive units, and drive inverters. This is a hands-on design role — you will own test solutions from concept through commissioning, working closely with validation engineers, technicians, and Tesla counterparts to ensure that the right equipment is in place to support program milestones.

What You’ll Do

- End-to-End Design: Lead the mechanical and electro-mechanical design (3D CAD, schematics, FEA) of test rigs, dynamometers, shaker fixtures, and HV distribution panels for battery, drive unit, and structural validation.
- Instrumentation & Integration: Specify and integrate sensors, actuators, and measurement equipment, collaborating with controls engineers to ensure seamless DAQ integration and CE/IEC/VDE safety compliance.
- Project Management: Own test equipment projects from concept through commissioning—managing vendors, scopes, and aggressive timelines while tracking deliverables via Jira/Confluence.
- Hands-On Commissioning: Drive the physical assembly, installation, and validation of test equipment on the shop floor, performing root-cause analysis on hardware issues.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with validation engineers, technicians, and global TSE teams to translate test objectives into robust, efficient equipment requirements and author comprehensive build documentation (BOMs, MIs).

What You’ll Bring

- Education & Experience: BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field, with 3+ years of hands-on experience designing electro-mechanical test systems or industrial machinery. EV powertrain or HV experience is strongly preferred.
- Mechanical Engineering Core: Proficiency in 3D CAD (CATIA V5 preferred), GD&T, structural/fatigue analysis (FEA), and diverse manufacturing processes (machining, weldments, sheet metal). Experience with rotating systems and rotor dynamics is a major plus.
- Test Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge in at least one of the following areas:
High Voltage / Battery: HV circuit design, safety interlocks, thermal conditioning, or pack-level fixtures.
Structural / Vibration: Shaker table fixtures, accelerometer instrumentation, and shock profiles (IEC/MIL-STD).
Drive Unit / Inverter: Dynamometer integration, torque measurement, and EOL test hardware.
- Electrical & DAQ: Solid understanding of high-voltage safety principles, measurement instrumentation (oscilloscopes, power analyzers), automotive protocols (CAN/LIN), and test automation frameworks (LabVIEW, Python).
- Soft Skills & Culture: Exceptional hands-on aptitude, strong project management skills, and the ability to self-direct in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Fluent English required; German language skills are a strong advantage.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Finance Business Analyst (f/m/d) for our Distribution Transformers business, covering six manufacturing locations worldwide, you will play a key role in supporting strategic Sales, T&O and DS initiatives while ensuring financial transparency and performance.
Working closely with plant controllers, performance analysts and cross-functional stakeholders, you will translate financial insights into business actions, harmonize reporting standards and contribute to productivity and cost optimization programs. Your work will help ensure that investments in innovation, digitalization and operational efficiency deliver measurable value and strengthen our position as a leading provider of reliable and sustainable transformer solutions.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Drive financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and operational excellence initiatives (e.g. productivity and cost-out programs) for Sales, T&O and DS across six global manufacturing sites.
* Consolidate, monitor and report key financial KPIs and expenditures while ensuring compliance with internal standards and external requirements.
* Prepare and analyse financial reports (e.g. Order Intake, Target Costing, Pricing and Margin Slippage) to support data-driven management decisions.
* Evaluate business cases for portfolio development, technology investments, process automation and resource optimization initiatives.
* Partner closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Management and DS teams to assess financial requirements and support strategic initiatives.
* Coordinate and guide plant controllers and performance analysts, driving standardized reporting, benchmarking and transparency across all sites.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field.
* Proven experience in financial controlling, ideally within manufacturing, industrial or energy-related environments.
* Expertise in financial planning, forecasting and performance analysis, combined with a solid understanding of operational excellence principles.
* Experience working in a multi-site and international business environment with diverse stakeholders.
* Proficiency in ERP systems (preferably SAP) and advanced analytical and financial modelling skills.
* Excellent communication skills, fluency in English, German is an advantage and willingness to travel internationally (approximately 10–20%). 

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is 
the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

The ideal candidate will bring initial professional experience in the mechanical design and verification of aerospace components (such as satellites, instruments, and mechanisms) and is eager to apply and further develop their academic and practical expertise.

Your location

At the Airbus site in Immenstaad, you work exactly where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power is taking shape. In an environment that offers visionary perspectives, you shape technological innovations across multiple domains.

Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you will encounter a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as the combat cloud and ground support systems of tomorrow. The way we work together is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, ranging from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. Anyone seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here.

About the LSM
The Graduate School Life Science Munich (LSM) is an international doctoral programme at one of Europe's leading research universities - Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München (LMU). The programme spans a wide range of disciplines including Biochemistry, Cell and Developmental Biology, Ecology, Genetics, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Plant Sciences, Zoology, and more. Doctoral candidates join a vibrant, diverse, and truly international research community at the LMU Biocenter in Planegg-Martinsried.

Doctoral Positions in Bioinformatics, Botany, Epigenetics, Ecology, Neuroscience, Plant Genetics, Systematic Zoology & more - Graduate School Life Science Munich (LSM), LMU Munich This year, two pathways are available:

A number of LSM faculty members are open to receiving original research proposals in specific areas. Rather than applying to a pre-defined project, candidates develop their own original proposal inspired by the research interests of a participating faculty member. Should a proposal be of interest to the potential supervisor, they would be willing to support the candidate in identifying and applying for appropriate funding - such as a fellowship, scholarship, or third-party funding.
Participating faculty members and their research areas:

Prof. Claude Becker - Epigenetics, epigenomics, plant-microbe interactions, biosynthetic gene clusters

Prof. Alexander Keller - Biodiversity, AI and computer vision, plant-pollinator interactions, ecological genomics

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES THE WHY We build pressure vessels and carbon structures for spaceflight. Before our hardware flies, it gets tested — and you keep the testing running. Without you, the test bench stands still. THE WHAT You prepare tests, help run them, and document the results. You work in the lab and at the test bench — hands-on, in a team, with real space hardware every day. Your tasks in detail:
• Prepare and post-process the testing areas: You set up test benches and specimens, tear down after tests, and keep the testing area ready for action. → High Performance: The test bench is ready when the team needs it.
• Run and document tests: You support destructive testing and acceptance testing (NDT) and record every step cleanly. → Accountability: What was tested is documented. No gaps.
• Say what you see: Anything unusual about a specimen, the test bench, or a result — you report it right away, not when someone asks. → Candor: You raise problems before they grow.
• Support the team and infrastructure: You pitch in where needed — in the testing team and with technical infrastructure on site. → Togetherness: We win as a team.
• Learn new things: NDT methods, new test procedures, new materials — you want to grow. We'll train you. → Playfulness: Curiosity is a strength here, not a distraction.

YOUR PROFILE
• Training: Completed vocational training as a materials tester / Werkstoffprüfer (plastics, metals, or fiber composites/CFRP) or comparable technical training.

• Work style: Motivated, reliable, hands-on. You want the job done — and done right.

#LI-Onsite

jobs.occupation: Head of Nuclear Controls Product Management (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Energietechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join us as the Team Lead for Nuclear Controls Product Management (f/m/d), where you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our Nuclear Instrumentation & Control (I&C) product portfolio. You will lead the strategic direction, ensuring commercial success and regulatory compliance for critical infrastructure applications. Imagine driving product strategy and roadmap decisions while acting as the key interface between customers, engineering, quality, operations, sales, and regulatory stakeholders. Your leadership will guide the product lifecycle management process, ensuring that our offerings meet the highest standards of safety and quality throughout their lifecycle.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Define and execute the global product strategy for the Nuclear Controls portfolio, securing an annual business volume of 100 million Euros
* Manage long-term product lifecycles, aligning with both new-build projects and multi-decade service commitments
* Drive product roadmap decisions, balancing standard product development with project-specific customization needs
* Oversee compliance with stringent international nuclear standards, licensing requirements, and safety-critical certification processes
* Navigate complex regulatory frameworks to ensure all product lines maintain necessary qualifications for global deployment
* Provide continuous strategic support and requirement engineering for key nuclear customers, fostering long-term partnerships

What You Bring

* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline
* Extensive professional experience in Product Management or Engineering within the nuclear industry or other highly regulated, safety-critical environments, including responsibility for large-scale product portfolios
* Proven leadership and management experience in senior roles, with a track record of leading cross-functional teams in an international environment
* Professional certifications in Product and/or Project Management, such as Certified Product Manager (AIPMM) or Project Management Professional (PMP), considered an asset
* Expertise in Product Management and Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), and the nuclear industry domain
* Strong strategic decision-making and stakeholder management capabilities, combined with business-fluent English and German language skills; French language skills are advantageous

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
